course.name: BMBS Medicine
course.notes: Standard-entry BMBS Medicine. Exeter does not publish a separate A101/A102/A104/A106 route in the supplied research; non-direct school leavers, including graduates more than two full academic years after level 3 study, use GAMSAT and are routed to manual review in ApplySmart.

selection_approach_display.default: Exeter uses the Exeter Score for direct school-leaver applicants, while non-direct school-leaver routes are assessed through GAMSAT.

by_applicant_pool.exeter_home_direct_school_leaver: Home direct school-leaver applicants are ranked using the Exeter Score, combining academic profile, UCAT decile and any applicable achieved-grade or confirmed WP/contextual uplift.
by_applicant_pool.exeter_international_direct_school_leave: International direct school-leaver applicants are ranked separately using the Exeter Score, combining academic profile, UCAT decile and any verified achieved-grade uplift.

medical_school.name: University of Exeter Medical School
medical_school.notes: Rules mapped from the user-supplied Exeter research document and the official BMBS Medicine Admissions Policy 2026 entry V4.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Direct school leavers are scored using the Exeter Score: academic profile plus UCAT decile, with conditional achieved-grade and WP contextual uplifts where evidenced.
International applicants are ranked separately. The same Exeter Score is used, but international interview places are constrained by quota.

Non-direct school leavers, including graduates more than two full academic years after level 3 study, use GAMSAT. ApplySmart records this route as manual review and does not automate GAMSAT Exeter Score ranking.

overall_policy.description: Applicants must meet the published academic entry requirements before Exeter Score shortlisting. Direct school leavers sit UCAT. Non-direct school leavers use GAMSAT and are manual review in ApplySmart.
not_eligible_if: The applicable A-level or IB academic requirement is not met.
Required Biology and Chemistry subject conditions are not met.
GCSE English Language grade B/6 is not met.
A valid UCAT score is missing for the direct school-leaver route.
The course-target UCAS code is not A100.

accepted_equivalencies: Equivalent English Language qualifications may be considered by Exeter.
gcse.sitting_policy: No additional executable GCSE sitting rule was supplied for the supported direct school-leaver route.
gcse.notes: The official policy extract states GCSE English Language grade B/6. No GCSE points score is used for Exeter Score.

a_level.notes: Typical offer A*AA including A in Biology and Chemistry. Contextual offer AAB including A in Biology and Chemistry.

ib.notes: Standard IB route: 38 points or 7,6,6 in three Higher Level subjects, including HL grade 6 in Biology and Chemistry. Contextual route: 34 points and 6,6,5 at HL including HL grade 6 in Biology and Chemistry.

subject_credits: 15 Level 3 Distinction credits in Biology subject area
15 Level 3 Distinction credits in Chemistry subject area
access_to_he.notes: Access requirements are documented but not used for automatic Exeter Score prediction in this implementation.

post_16.notes: Direct school-leaver A-level routes are executable for Exeter Score prediction. IB routes are eligibility-checked but do not receive an automated Exeter Score in this implementation. GAMSAT/non-direct school-leaver, unsupported equivalence and Access routes are documented manual-review boundaries.

national_5.notes: Current A100 evidence records Scottish Nationals as N/A; no National 5 requirement is inferred from Exeter GCSE rules.

higher_offer.notes: AAAAA at Higher including Biology A and Chemistry A.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: AAA at Advanced Higher including Biology A and Chemistry A.

grade_requirements.notes: Higher route is qualification-driven and is not gated by Scotland domicile.
Advanced Higher route is qualification-driven and is not gated by Scotland domicile.

scottish.notes: No contextual Scottish reduced offer is implemented; Exeter contextual AAB is A-level only.

ucat.minimum_total_score_basis: Exeter publishes no standalone minimum UCAT score for direct school leavers; UCAT decile contributes to the Exeter Score.
ucat.notes: SJT is not used for Exeter A100 pre-interview selection.

sjt.notes: The supplied research and official policy state SJT is not used as a gate or scoring component.

other_tests.notes: Non-direct school leavers use GAMSAT. ApplySmart does not automate Exeter GAMSAT scoring in this implementation.

resits.conditions: No hidden resit penalty was supplied, but resit edge cases remain manual review.

exemptions: Verified English-language exemption or accepted equivalent
english_language.notes: International applicants must meet Exeter Profile G English-language requirements. The generic engine checks IELTS Academic 7.0 overall and in each component unless an exemption flag is supplied.

age_or_professional_checks.age_date: 8 September in the first year of the programme
age_or_professional_checks.notes: Professional checks are post-selection and do not drive interview prediction.

ranking_factors.notes: The executable component stores the grade-profile base score before UCAT decile and conditional uplifts.
Configured from Exeter's rule that score decreases by four points per UCAT decile row.

score_components.calculation_method: Published Exeter Score grade-profile table represented as base points before UCAT decile row adjustment.
score_components.notes: A*A*A* = 58, A*A*A = 48, A*AA = 38, AAA = 28, AAB = 18, ABB = 8 at the lowest decile row before UCAT decile points.

score_components.calculation_method: Shared UCAT national decile lookup mapped to Exeter's four-points-per-row decile contribution.
score_components.notes: Historical FOI-derived UCAT equivalents are not used for prediction.

score_components.calculation_method: Add 10 points only where the qualification status is achieved.
score_components.notes: This is a generic conditional score component, not Exeter-specific engine code.

score_components.input_field: confirmed Exeter contextual eligibility from the dedicated contextual evaluator
score_components.calculation_method: Add 5 points only where Exeter contextual eligibility has been confirmed.
score_components.notes: The dedicated Exeter contextual evaluator is the sole executable authority for this +5 uplift. Legacy contextual/WP declarations alone must not award points.

total_score.notes: Applicable maximums are predicted non-contextual 90, predicted confirmed-contextual/WP 95, achieved non-contextual 100, and achieved confirmed-contextual/WP 105.

thresholds.notes: Used as interview-guidance context, not a future guarantee. Contextual applicants use the AAB academic eligibility route where verified; confirmed contextual/WP applicants receive the published +5 Exeter Score uplift.
International applicants are ranked separately because only about 30 interview places are expected for 10 international places.

selection_adjustments.notes: Applied only after dedicated Exeter contextual eligibility is confirmed.

tie_breakers.notes: Offer-stage tie-break only; not used for interview prediction.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Shortlisting is numerical. Confirmed Exeter contextual/WP applicants receive the published +5 Exeter Score uplift; personal statements, references and work experience are not scored for interview shortlisting.

criteria: Structured Step 6 Exeter contextual offer evidence: postcode deprivation where applicable, state-school dependency where required, free school meals, care experience, refugee/asylum/humanitarian status, estrangement, caring responsibility, parental responsibility, or recognised Exeter/widening-participation programme evidence.

adjustments.value: AAB including grade A in Biology and Chemistry
adjustments.notes: The published +5 Exeter Score uplift is executable only for applicants confirmed by the dedicated Exeter contextual evaluator.
Separate from the contextual academic offer. Applied only when Exeter contextual eligibility is confirmed.

contextual_admissions.notes: Confirmed contextual eligibility can affect both the published contextual academic offer and the Exeter Score. It does not guarantee an interview.

ranking_pools.name: Home direct school-leaver pool
ranking_pools.notes: Home applicants are ranked by Exeter Score. The OfS maximum fundable limit is stored as capacity context only.

ranking_pools.name: International direct school-leaver pool
ranking_pools.notes: International applicants are ranked separately; approximately 30 international applicants are interviewed.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
Maximum fundable limit, used as context only.
International fixed limit in supplied research, used as context only.

interview_format.notes: Interviews are Multiple Mini Interviews. Station details are not used for prediction.

interview_scoring.notes: Offers are made based on interview outcome; post-interview prediction remains out of scope.

ranking_factors: UCAT score only as an offer-stage tie-break where needed
tie_breakers: UCAT score may be used where there are many applicants in the eligible offer pool with the same Exeter Score.
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: reserve list may be used for certain late corrected predicted-grade errors
offer_selection.standard_offer: A*AA including grade A in Biology and Chemistry
offer_selection.contextual_offer: AAB including grade A in Biology and Chemistry

cycles.notes: Stored as guidance thresholds for Exeter Score, not as raw UCAT cut-offs or offer prediction.

historical_admissions.notes: FOI-derived raw UCAT equivalents in the research document are retained as explanatory historical context only and are not executable prediction inputs.

validation.confidence_level: High for direct school-leaver Exeter Score; medium for guidance thresholds
known_unknowns: Automated GAMSAT/non-direct school-leaver Exeter Score route.
validation.review_notes: Contextual score is implemented as the official +5 uplift only. No separate lower contextual threshold is applied.

engine_notes.supported_scope: Direct school-leaver A-level applicants using UCAT, including achieved/predicted grades and the 2027 contextual AAB academic route. Scottish Higher/Advanced Higher academic eligibility is qualification-checked through the shared Scottish evaluator. IB is eligibility-checked but not automatically Exeter-scored.
engine_assumptions: The shared UCAT decile lookup is used to derive the Exeter UCAT decile contribution from a raw UCAT cognitive total.
Score guidance thresholds are guidance only and not offer prediction.
Confirmed Exeter contextual applicants may use the contextual AAB academic route and receive the published +5 Exeter Score uplift where applicable.
do_not_infer: Do not use historical FOI-derived raw UCAT equivalents to drive Exeter prediction.
Do not add both the +5 contextual uplift and a lower contextual threshold.
